Design.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/4] Each subject participated in only one treatment.

country.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/4] All sessions took place at the decision laboratory of the Department of Economics at the University of Zurich in June 2012. ... Subjects were students from the University of Zurich and the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH) in Zurich.

info_cost.evidence_source: [/page/10/Text/0] Payoffs from the game, denominated in "points" were converted into money at the rate of 2 points to CHF 1 (about $1 at the time of the experiment) at the end of the experiment. On average, subjects earned CHF 39.80 in the baseline sessions and CHF 41.30 in the hidden information sessions. These amounts include a show-up fee of CHF 15.

extract_value.key: hidden information treatment vs baseline treatment

Sample.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/3] We conducted four sessions of the baseline treatment with 81 subjects in total (27 subjects in the role of the dictator and 54 subjects in the role of the receiver/third party). We also conducted four sessions of the hidden information treatment with 90 subjects in total (30 subjects in the role of the dictator and 60 subjects in the role of the receiver/third party).
